summary: Assess AI proposals, risks and oversight needs without coding. Explore the five-day AI primer for leaders and review the course outline.
lede: AI leadership training helps executives, department heads and programme sponsors assess proposals and set practical oversight without coding. Participants distinguish predictive from generative AI, screen use cases for value and data readiness, and review model or vendor evidence. They also map accountability, risk controls and human oversight, then develop an initial AI opportunity and risk brief.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who evaluate AI proposals, sponsor pilots or oversee teams adopting AI tools. It suits professionals who need enough fluency to challenge assumptions and make accountable decisions without building models or writing code.
modules: AI Leadership Context and Use Cases
NIST AI RMF Governance and Mapping
AI Use-Case Portfolio and Value Scores
NIST Generative AI Profile for Leaders
NIST AI RMF Reporting and Roadmaps
prerequisites: No prior AI or programming experience is expected. Familiarity with organizational decisions, budgets or operational priorities will help you apply the leadership scenarios. Coding is not required; advanced AI and model topics receive conceptual treatment.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
